head: 1700ed37e82a6028cfa40c86b35db7621dd50404
body:
Restore the public Schema 21 job/cache/search tests to the physical Operational and Search stores, preserving frozen job plans, atomic attempt results, failure injection, restart behavior, immutable acquisition identity and Core-only backups. Resolve transient acquisition IDs before separate Core assertions; no ATTACH, compatibility tables or public P1–P7 migration.

The corrected Search assertion exposed a production defect: retained old-generation documents were copied into every replacement generation. Rebuild now selects only the current pinned Core projection, preserves the prior ready generation on cancellation, and prunes obsolete derivatives after normal generation retirement. A real 201-issue regression covers an entirely obsolete SQL batch, cancellation, repeated rebuilds, empty replacement and unchanged historical Core text.

Dependencies: this PR stacks on [#93](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/pull/93), `fix/schema21-collection-contract`. Merge commits are preferred; owner authorization is pending and no auto-merge is enabled.

Validation so far: original stale-projection reproduction fails on unchanged production; original regression plus 201-issue lifecycle pass after correction (2 passed). Explicit job boundary/atomic rollback tests pass (2 passed). Ruff check/format, implementation-boundary and call-site audits pass; generated audit references updated. Production source is frozen at `31b7bf3d734c92ad10d22cca233d4318932dfce3`; the ordinary dependency merge `c5db95520f2d54dac675c6d3aa3be8f955cad4e7` preserves all production and selected-cohort Python inputs. The complete owned cohort passes: **104 passed, 0 failed/errors/skips**, with exact JUnit/journal node/status reconciliation. This resolves all 24 inherited failures in this PR scope plus the additional current-main fencing failure. Reviewer A independently approved the architecture and 42 relevant regressions passed. Final HEAD `1700ed37e82a6028cfa40c86b35db7621dd50404` merges only the foundation evidence follow-up; all source, tests, scripts and locked build inputs are unchanged from the tested commit. Raw execution and classification evidence is preserved for the integrated evidence PR. A prior `/tmp` disk-exhaustion run is retained and explicitly excluded from acceptance; the full cohort was rerun using a workspace temporary directory. Development CI is not full runtime acceptance.
